integrity: Full derivation, exact rational adjacency-matrix checker, and recorded output are supplied. No independent validation or exhaustive literature certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Unsigned line graphs of simple two-cycle dumbbells only, with arbitrary cycle lengths \(a,b\ge3\) and connecting path length \(d\ge1\); not cacti with extra attachments. title: Complete line-graph adjacency inertia and sharp signature threshold for cycle dumbbells
